cohort: 3675 pregnant women in 11 provinces across Iran
finding: The study found a decreasing trend in GDM prevalence in Iran, but GDM was still associated with increased odds of adverse pregnancy outcomes such as stillbirth, neonatal deaths, macrosomia, preterm birth, abortion, and C-section delivery.
mod_finding: This study found that pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus had a higher prevalence of cesarean section delivery compared to non-diabetic women.
